# Kidus Sendeke

> Software engineer in Seattle, WA. Builds distributed systems and AI-enabled applications. Formerly Microsoft (M365 Substrate) and Visa. Founder of 50 Limes (፶ ሎሚ), a product studio: https://50limes.com M.S. Computer Science (Data Science) candidate at Seattle University, graduating Spring 2027.

## Current
- Software Engineer (contract via Blueprint Technologies) at Microsoft Philanthropies: full-stack, AI-enabled applications in C#/.NET, TypeScript, Azure OpenAI and the Microsoft Bot Builder SDK.

## Experience
- Microsoft, Software Engineer, M365 Substrate, Redmond WA (Nov 2020 – Apr 2024): C# SharePoint ingestion API (40% faster file processing), global rate-limiting availability (+20%), QPS analysis and dynamic shard feeding (+25% resource allocation), SCOPE big-data pipeline (+30% validation accuracy), on-call for 5 critical services at 99.9% uptime, mentored two interns.
- Visa Inc., Software Engineer, Austin TX (Sep 2019 – Oct 2020): Python/Selenium automation (-50% test time), Go EBCDIC-to-ASCII converter (halved processing time), regression and volume testing.
- Visa Inc., Software Engineer Intern, Austin TX (Jun – Sep 2018): Angular project tracker, D3.js/Chart.js dashboards, MongoDB schemas.
